lines.x: The Malaysian ringgit appreciated to 4.1100 against the U.S.
Benchmark February palm oil futures on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange dropped 2.68% to 4,217 ringgit ($1,026.28) per metric ton, touching an eight-month low.
Malaysia's economy grew 5.5% year-on-year in the third quarter, surpassing advance government and analyst estimates of 5.3%, propelled by sustained domestic consumption and tech exports.
Bursa Malaysia opened lower on Friday as global equity selling and tech valuation concerns pulled the benchmark FBM KLCI below 1,560.
